Çiğ Kadayıf (Dondurulmuş)

Raw Shredded Kadayif (Frozen)

Tufan Organik Raw Shredded Kadayif (Frozen) belongs to the Kadayıf Varieties range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

كنافة شعر نيئة (مجمدة)

Rohes Kadayif-Engelshaar (tiefgefroren)
